2021 XACT 5448 midvalve trampoline cup v2

KTM 250/300 XC / Husqvarna TX 300 2021, XACT 5448 midvalve, setting list 34188U73. Animations of the cup and stack moving from rest, through float, to full trampoline travel at the stop collar. Each loops continuously (about 6 seconds).

1. Section drawing with controls2. Section drawing only3. Flow view with controls4. Flow view only

1. Section drawing with controls

The full panel: position buttons, Opening slider, live readout and legend.

2. Section drawing only

The drawing alone: float first, then trampoline travel to the stop collar. The Float and Travel labels count down the remaining movement.

3. Flow view with controls

Compression flow through one compression port and one rebound port of the MV piston, with its own slider, caption and notes.

4. Flow view only

The flow drawing alone: oil lifts the main stack off the MV piston face, then the trampoline stack moves into the cup. The float spring compresses along with the stack.

Created 2026-10-18. Standalone page: the animations are embedded in this file.
